content.stem: 以下哪个陈述最准确地描述了谁必须遵守美国海外资产控制办公室（OFAC）的制裁措施？

options.A: 所有身处美国境内的美国公民和永久居民、所有在美国注册成立的实体及其外国分支机构，以及所有在美国境内的个人
options.B: 所有美国公民和永久居民，无论身处何地；所有在美国注册成立的实体，但不包括其外国分支机构；以及所有在美国境内的个人和实体
options.C: 所有美国公民（双重国籍者除外）、美国永久居民、所有在美国注册成立的实体，以及所有在美国境内的个人
options.D: 所有美国公民和永久居民，无论身处何地；所有在美国注册成立的实体及其外国分支机构；以及所有在美国境内的个人和实体

content.stem_en: Which statement is the most accurate describing who must comply with Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) sanctions?

options_en.A: All U.S. citizens and permanent residents while located in the United States, all U.S.-incorporated entities and their foreign branches, and all individuals within the United States
options_en.B: All U.S. citizens and permanent residents regardless of where they are located, all U.S.-incorporated entities excluding their foreign branches, and all individuals and entities within the United States
options_en.C: All U.S. citizens except those with dual nationality, U.S. permanent residents, all U.S.-incorporated entities, and all individuals within the United States
options_en.D: All U.S. citizens and permanent residents regardless of where they are located, all U.S.-incorporated entities and their foreign branches, and all individuals and entities within the United States
